questions.question: If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2017?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then the day on these dates will be:

21 May 2010 → Friday

21 May 2011 → Saturday

21 May 2012 → Monday

21 May 2013 → Tuesday

21 May 2014 → Wednesday

21 May 2015 → Thursday

21 May 2016 → Saturday

21 May 2017 → Sunday

Number of days between 21 May 2017 to 15 July 2017 = (10 + 30 + 15) = 55

55 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Sunday + 6 = Saturday

Therefore, it will be Saturday on 15 July 2017.

Hence, ‘**Saturday**’ is the correct answer.

• It is the radioactive isotope with a half-life of 5770 years that is commonly used to estimate the age of organic materials such as paper and parchment.

• Carbon-14 dating is a widely used method in archaeology, paleontology, and other fields to determine the age of artifacts and fossils.

• The correct relationship between Lg and Lm is important in the design and analysis of electrical machines and devices such as transformers and motors.
 
• This relationship is derived from the fact that the magnetic length is shorter than the geometric length due to the presence of end effects.
 
• **The relationship between geometric length (Lg) and magnetic length (Lm) is Lm = (5)/(6) * Lg.**
